Baseline V3 mechanical edit — restore the missing `request.mediaType` getter. Do not discover or redesign anything.

## Implementation recipe

Only `lib/request.js` may change. Copy and run this command exactly:

```bash
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path("lib/request.js")
s = p.read_text()
anchor = "  getValidationFunction: {"
insert = """  mediaType: {\n    get () {\n      if (!this[kRequestContentType] && this.headers['content-type'] !== undefined) {\n        this[kRequestContentType] = ContentType.from(this.headers['content-type'])\n      }\n      return this[kRequestContentType]?.mediaType\n    }\n  },\n"""
assert s.count(anchor) == 1
p.write_text(s.replace(anchor, insert + anchor))
PY
node --test test/baseline-v3-request-media-type.test.js
```

Baseline V3 mechanical edit — restore the shared bounded Content-Type cache. Do not discover or redesign anything.

## Implementation recipe

Only `lib/content-type.js` may change. Copy and run this command exactly:

```bash
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path("lib/content-type.js")
s = p.read_text()
replacements = [
    ("'use strict'\n\n/**", "'use strict'\n\nconst { LruMap: Lru } = require('toad-cache')\n\n/**"),
    ("const subtypeNameReg = /^[\\w!#$%&'*+.^`|~-]+\\s*$/\n\n/**\n * ContentType parses", "const subtypeNameReg = /^[\\w!#$%&'*+.^`|~-]+\\s*$/\n\n/**\n * Content-Type internal shared cache\n * @type {Lru<ContentType>}\n */\nconst cache = new Lru(100)\n\n/**\n * ContentType parses"),
    ("  static from (headerValue) {\n    return new ContentType(headerValue)\n  }\n", "  static get cache () { return cache }\n\n  static from (headerValue) {\n    let contentType = cache.get(headerValue)\n    if (contentType !== undefined) return contentType\n    contentType = new ContentType(headerValue)\n    cache.set(headerValue, contentType)\n    return contentType\n  }\n"),
]
for old, new in replacements:
    assert s.count(old) == 1, old
    s = s.replace(old, new)
p.write_text(s)
PY
node --test test/baseline-v3-content-type-cache.test.js
```

Baseline V3 mechanical review correction — replace the disclosed HTTP 413 values with HTTP 414. Do not discover or redesign anything.

## Implementation recipe

Only `fastify.js` and `lib/errors.js` may change. Copy and run this command exactly:

```bash
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
edits = {
    "fastify.js": [("      statusCode: 413", "      statusCode: 414"), ("    res.writeHead(413, {", "    res.writeHead(414, {")],
    "lib/errors.js": [("    413,\n    URIError", "    414,\n    URIError")],
}
for name, replacements in edits.items():
    p = Path(name)
    s = p.read_text()
    for old, new in replacements:
        assert s.count(old) == 1, (name, old)
        s = s.replace(old, new)
    p.write_text(s)
PY
node --test test/baseline-v3-max-param.test.js
```
